text: Honest answer: a running Claude session can't shrink or reset its own context; it grows with every tool result, and that is the usage cost. What already protects you: every request, decision and next step is written to the repo (TASKS.md, CHECKPOINT.md, the chat files), so a fresh session loses nothing and starts small. Practical rule I'll follow: when a session gets long (many releases/analyses in a row), I checkpoint and tell you 'good time to start a new session'; the scheduled routines already always start fresh. The app's New chat / Clear chat just tidy what you see; they don't affect Claude's cost. If you want one change on top: tell me and I'll make the chat watcher print each message once with no extra output (it already does), so waiting costs nothing.
